name: ManifestV3 Test PAM Provider
description: The ManifestV3 Test PAM Provider allows for the retrieval of stored account credentials from an ManifestV3 Test secret.

Parameters.Name: Url
Parameters.Description: The URL to the ManifestV3 Test instance. Defaults to: https://api.manifestV3Test.io

Parameters.Name: AccessKeyId
Parameters.Description: The access key ID used to authenticate to ManifestV3 Test using `access_key` authentication.

Parameters.Name: AccessKey
Parameters.Description: The access key used to authenticate to ManifestV3 Test using `access_key` authentication.

Parameters.Name: AuthType
Parameters.Description: The auth type used to authenticate to the ManifestV3 Test platform. Supported types are `access_key`.

Parameters.Name: SecretName
Parameters.Description: The full name (path) of the secret in ManifestV3 Test that contains the credential to retrieve.

Parameters.Name: SecretType
Parameters.Description: The type of secret stored in ManifestV3 Test. Supported types are `static_kv,static_text,static_json`.

Parameters.Name: StaticSecretFieldName
Parameters.Description: The field name within a static secret to retrieve the credential from. Required for `static_kv` and optional for `static_json` secret types.
